released_12_role: frozen benchmark reference; no silent weight transplant
purpose: Improve track and pressure-map forecasts together using the existing richer weather observations

global_context.source: existing observed NCEP context, not old 1.3 forecasts

input.storm_history: observed positions, pressure, motion and definition-tagged wind through issue time, with explicit missingness
input.geopotential_units: m2/s2; divide by 9.80665 only when converting to height in metres

architecture_proposal.name: Joint multiscale weather and cyclone evolution
architecture_proposal.history_encoder: Shared per-frame multivariate encoder plus temporal recurrent/attention aggregation; preserve channel masks and age
architecture_proposal.global_branch: New periodic-longitude context processor, autoregressively predicting its own future context
architecture_proposal.regional_branch: New full-WP multiscale encoder/decoder with native-grid skip features, recurrent state and coarse-token cross attention
architecture_proposal.size_selection: Measure actual parameter count, all20-step runtime and TRAIN gradient/fit evidence before selecting width; bigger alone is not a skill claim
architecture_proposal.evolution: Six-hour learned residual evolution of the joint weather state, not passive advection of MSLP by surface wind
architecture_proposal.storm_state: Joint cyclone-existence/association state with observed issue identities and learned future motion; no global soft-argmin averaging two different lows
architecture_proposal.core: Conditioned spatial pressure residual learned with best-track supervision; carried in physical coordinates and integrated into the same full-WP pressure product
architecture_proposal.pressure_readout: Bilinear sampling of that exact exported canonical pressure product at the associated forecast centre
architecture_proposal.core_truth_caveat: Best-track point pressure is not a dense observed pressure field; reconstructed inner-core shapes remain model estimates
architecture_proposal.storm_survival: Learned existence and explicit support masks; neither forced disappearance nor forced indefinite survival
architecture_proposal.probabilistic_extension: Deferred until deterministic field/track consistency passes; then test coherent latent/member trajectories, not pixel-noise cosmetics

objective_proposal.field: TRAIN-normalized, spherical-area-weighted weather increment error with channel masks
objective_proposal.structure: Multiscale pressure gradient, wind vorticity and divergence diagnostics/losses using physical distance; no hard geostrophic constraint in the cyclone core
objective_proposal.cyclone: Position/existence, agency-specific pressure, motion and pressure-change supervision, with missing labels excluded
objective_proposal.pressure_target_conflict: Do not force a deep cyclone core to regress to a systematically shallow reanalysis minimum; distinguish environmental field supervision from sparse observed core pressure
objective_proposal.core_field_loss_ablation: Compare unmodified dense ERA5 fitting against explicit masked inner-core dense loss plus observed pressure/position constraints; choose coefficients on TRAIN-only tuning
objective_proposal.sampling: Full eligible TRAIN corpus; report equal-storm and per-start scores. Any rare-intensity sampling must retain stated target weighting or use inverse-proposal correction
objective_proposal.rollout: TRAIN curriculum 1, 2, 4, 8, 20 steps; validation always all20. Later inputs are own predictions, never future observed weather
objective_proposal.normalization: New train-only per-channel and increment scales, separately for ERA5 and NCEP; do not reuse 1.2 eight-channel normalization for 31 channels

experiments.description: Fresh new architecture using only the eight comparable atmospheric fields, others masked; same parameters and draws as B
Same architecture using all31 fields; same objective as A, isolate extra weather information
B plus joint field/cyclone and core-target-conflict treatment; isolate the objective change

evaluation.development: All811 fixed starts, all24 development storms, all20 leads; repeatedly used development, not an untouched holdout
evaluation.fixed11: Original catalogue/issue times and released1.2 reference unchanged; six native input windows missing in this cache
pressure: central-pressure MAE and bias hPa by agency
consistency: exported scalar equals same-map readout within declared tolerance
same issue/valid time/member/geography for map and track
no shifted or scalar-painted pressure maps
evaluation.comparison_policy: New .25-degree model versus 1.2 at common actual support; native-detail errors separately. Do not score interpolated2.5-degree reference as native.25 truth
evaluation.aggregation: Primary equal-storm paired metrics and storm-cluster bootstrap intervals; per-start supplementary; all predeclared leads retained
evaluation.promotion: Require evidence for track AND pressure improvements, inspect tail/landfall regressions and coverage; no automatic promotion from training loss or appearance
evaluation.untouched_holdout: Not currently certified; do not rebrand repeatedly inspected2024-2026 cases as new holdout
